content:
kevin_sales: TheraQ wants to run a 4-week POC using their finetuned Orpheus-13B-electra variant. Main asks: HIPAA posture, KMS integration, and p95 <200ms for single-stream inference. Can we support on Dedicated or will it need Private?
talia_support: Quick checklist: need model tarball, tokenizer.json, optims used (flash attention?), and whether they used fused kernels. Also confirm if they trained with groupnorm or layernorm.
ravi_ml: Pulled their tarball from S3 link. Model is 13B, uses GroupNorm + custom fused FFN. Tokenizer is SentencePiece. Quick local run (cpu debug): tokens align but we see OOM on int8 conversion without custom ffn fallback.
marta_infra: For p95 <200ms single stream on 13B int8 we'd want at least 1x A100s or 2x A10G depending on batch. Dedicated can do it; Private recommended if they insist on customer-managed HSM keys.
lina_sec: From security: HIPAA requires BAAs and audit logs, encryption-at-rest, and key control. If they need HSM-backed keys, Private deployment or on-prem is required. Also request completed security questionnaire v2.
kevin_sales: Pricing/commit question: customer expects a fixed pilot price. They're OK with a short commit: 1 month, baseline 300k tokens/day, bursting to 1M. Any rough numbers?
talia_support: Rough pilot cost estimate: Dedicated small pool + support = ~$10k-14k/mo, token overage billed separately. Need @finance to confirm. Add legal for BAA terms.
ravi_ml: Compatibility plan: 1) Try int8 conversion with our adaptor to handle fused FFN -> may need a small shim. 2) If shim required, runtime team estimated 4 biz days including perf runs. I can prototype adaptor patch. Example run config for POC: ```
model: orpheus-13b-electra
variant: orpheus-13b-electra-int8
quant: int8
tokenizer: sentencepiece
optimizations: [ffn-fallback-adaptor, kv_cache, continuous-batching]
runtime: dedicated
```
marta_infra: I'll open INFRA-4782 for Dedicated pilot sizing + BAA routing. We need SOW sign before provisioning. Tagging deploy-bot for canary after runtime patch.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: job/theraq-orpheus-canary in 72h post-PR merge.
kevin_sales: Action items: I will send SOW template + security questionnaire v2 to TheraQ, request BAA. @ravi_ml start adaptor spike. @marta_infra create infra ticket and estimate.
lina_sec: Also ask them about logging retention and PHI flows. We'll need an architecture diagram.
talia_support: I'll collect tokenizer + reproducible inference script from the customer to speed onboarding.
kevin_sales: Thanks all. I'll update TheraQ and push the SOW. :rocket:
